messages:
julia_customer: Hey team — noticed two charges for our annual renewal today. I see INV-2026-09 and INV-2026-09-01. PO PR-7782 requires a single invoice. Both charges posted to card ending 4242. Can someone help?

alex_support: Sorry about this, Julia. Can you confirm the two invoice numbers and the last4? We'll escalate to billing.

julia_customer: Confirming: INV-2026-09 and INV-2026-09-01, card ****4242, PO PR-7782, billing@betaretail.com. Need one reversed and a credit note for PO accounting.

meera_billing: Thanks — starting investigation. @sam_engr can you check payment capture logs? Julia, we'll need the PO and the billing contact (got it).

sam_engr: Quick look at logs: two captures for the same subscription within ~15s. Same external payment token. Looks like a retry path created a second capture — idempotency header not applied on one retry. Raising a fix to the billing webhook.

meera_billing: We'll process a refund for the duplicate charge now and issue a credit note tied to PR-7782. Refund being created against the later capture. Refund id: rf_1MZ7a2XYZ. Bank/card reversal typically 3-10 business days depending on the issuer. :pray:

alex_support: Created internal ticket SUP-2026-447 and linked the invoices. Julia I will DM you the credit note when it's ready.

julia_customer: Appreciate the fast response. Will accounting need a revised invoice number for our PO?

meera_billing: Yes — we will issue a replacement invoice and a credit note. Credit note: CN-2026-55, replacement invoice: INV-2026-09-R. We'll put PO PR-7782 on both docs.

sam_engr: Follow-up: pushing a small change to add idempotency header on the retry path. Example header we already use on normal flow:

```
Idempotency-Key: invoice_INV-2026-09
```

That should prevent duplicate captures on retries. Monitoring for any other duplicates.

refund-bot: Refund rf_1MZ7a2XYZ status: succeeded (gateway acknowledged). Reversal posting ETA: 3-7 business days, card issuer dependent.

julia_customer: I see a pending refund on our statement now, and CN-2026-55 arrived in our inbox. Thanks — I'll confirm once reconciled. :thumbsup: 

alex_support: Thanks Julia — we'll keep the support ticket open until you confirm reconciliation. Reopen anytime if the reversal doesn't appear in the stated timeframe.

meera_billing: Action items logged: 1) refund rf_1MZ7a2XYZ (processed), 2) credit note CN-2026-55 issued, 3) replacement invoice INV-2026-09-R created with PO PR-7782. Timeline notes included for finance.
